scope: common 0.7 / scope 12 database capacity observation gap and upload sampling availability

initial_gap.database: No database-size gauge or unknown sample alert. Existing connection pool, memory/CPU/PID budgets, log rotation and payload retention did not observe PostgreSQL disk growth.
initial_gap.upload: Existing UPLOAD_DIR FileStore ratio started at 1 and retained a previous healthy value when missing or failing; disk sampling was behind JDBC aggregates.

implementation.query_timeout: Dedicated JdbcTemplate, DB_CAPACITY_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS default 2, bounded to 1-5 seconds; datasource acquisition retains existing connection-pool timeout.
implementation.warning: DB_SIZE_WARNING_BYTES must be positive; default 10737418240 (10 GiB). Observation threshold only, no hard quota, deletion or business admission change.
implementation.unknown_behavior: Initial/failed database sample exposes NaN size and available=0, retains last successful sample age without presenting old bytes as current. Upload missing/error sample exposes NaN ratio and available=0.
implementation.scrape_behavior: Database metric reads only access cached immutable sample state; no SQL per scrape. Upload filesystem sampling is separate from the earlier JDBC aggregate refresh.

alerts.TripDatabaseSizeHigh: Successful sample, age <=180 seconds and measured size > configured warning, sustained 2 minutes.
alerts.TripCapacitySamplingUnknown: Database/upload sample unavailable or absent, or database sample age >180 seconds, sustained 2 minutes.
alerts.TripDiskLow: Upload ratio <10% requires an available sample; unknown is handled by the separate unknown alert.

targeted_verification.database_tests: 3 passed: actual isolated PostgreSQL database size, cached metric reads do not open connections, configured threshold does not block measurement, real PostgreSQL authentication failure after a healthy sample clears NaN/available, age remains and successful recovery resamples, invalid warning rejected.
targeted_verification.upload_tests: 2 passed: missing path is unknown initially/after sampling; a real test-only directory is renamed and retained after a healthy sample, then missing-path sampling clears the healthy value despite independent JDBC aggregate failure.
targeted_verification.database_mutation: None: authentication failure changes only the test DriverManagerDataSource password; no PostgreSQL role, table, database or server setting is changed.

prometheus_rule_tests.execution: pending coordinator; no local promtool binary and this subtask was instructed not to operate Docker
prometheus_rule_tests.command: promtool test rules <test-directory>/alerts.capacity.test.yml (alerts.yml must be in the same directory)
prospective_cases: Successful fresh database size above warning triggers size alert without unknown/low-upload false alerts.
Size exactly at warning does not trigger high alert or unknown.
Success followed by failed NaN/unavailable sample triggers unknown, not old high-size alert.
Available flag plus old database sample still triggers unknown by age.
Unknown upload sample triggers unknown, not false low-upload/high-database alerts.
prometheus_rule_tests.not_claimed: Rule fixture authoring or YAML inspection is not Prometheus rule execution or notification delivery evidence.

boundaries: pg_database_size measures current database files, not free bytes on the PostgreSQL filesystem, Docker Desktop virtual disk or physical host.
WAL, temporary files, other databases and host/other-container growth need separate physical PG mount/host capacity monitoring.
Upload and PostgreSQL use different mounts and logical quotas; this does not prove separate physical capacity or independent failure domains on one host.
Sampling/alerts do not implement hard database quotas, production capacity guarantees, automatic deletion or high availability.
Longer sample intervals require review of the fixed 180-second freshness alert threshold.
Final candidate image, actual scrape/alert rule execution and alert delivery remain coordinator evidence. No candidate or daily container was rebuilt by this subtask.

frozen_holdout.statement: New capacity service, BusinessMetrics, alert files and targeted test files are outside the frozen 27 source fingerprints. The first holdout score remains 16/17 and is not rerun.

root_promtool_validation.boundary: Rule evaluation with synthetic metric series; not production storage capacity or a hard quota.
